candidate.title: Recover a stuck migration lock
candidate.problem: A schema migration aborts and leaves an advisory lock held, so every later migration blocks forever.
signals: could not obtain advisory lock for migration
applicability: the migration runner uses a database advisory lock
no migration process is still running
candidate.root_cause: The aborted process never released the advisory lock.
candidate.approach: Confirm no runner is alive, then release the lock explicitly and rerun the migration. https://ci-bot:CORPUSFIXTUREpassword@github.com/acme/helios-ledger.git
constraints: releasing a lock a live runner holds corrupts the migration
